contents.emmetSyntaxProfiles: Define profile untuk specified syntax atau use your own profile dengan specific rules.
contents.emmetExclude: Larik languages where Emmet abbreviations should not be dibentangkan.
contents.emmetExtensionsPath:
Larik paths, where each path can contain Emmet syntaxProfiles dan/atau snippet berkas.
In case of conflicts, the profiles/snippets of later paths will override those of earlier paths.
See https://code.visualstudio.com/docs/editor/emmet untuk more information dan an example snippet berkas.
contents.emmetExtensionsPathItem: A path containing Emmet syntaxProfiles dan/atau snippets.
contents.emmetShowExpandedAbbreviation:
Shows dibentangkan Emmet abbreviations as suggestions.
The option `"inMarkupAndStylesheetFilesOnly"` applies to html, haml, jade, slim, xml, xsl, css, scss, sass, less dan stylus.
The option `"always"` applies to all parts of the berkas regardless of markup/css.
contents.emmetShowAbbreviationSuggestions: Shows possible Emmet abbreviations as suggestions. Not applicable in stylesheets atau when emmet.showExpandedAbbreviation is set to `"never"`.
contents.emmetIncludeLanguages:
Aktifkan Emmet abbreviations in languages that are not supported secara bawaan. Add a mapping here between the language dan Emmet supported language.
 untuk example: `{"vue-html": "html", "javascript": "javascriptreact"}`
contents.emmetVariables: Variables to be used in Emmet snippets.
contents.emmetTriggerExpansionOnTab: Saat diaktifkan, Emmet abbreviations are dibentangkan when pressing TAB, even when completions do not tampilkan up. When dinonaktifkan, completions that tampilkan up can still be accepted oleh pressing TAB.
contents.emmetPreferences: preferensi used to modify behavior of some actions dan resolvers of Emmet.
contents.emmetPreferencesCssAfter: Symbol to be placed at the end of CSS property when membentangkan CSS abbreviations.
contents.emmetPreferencesSassAfter: Symbol to be placed at the end of CSS property when membentangkan CSS abbreviations in Sass berkas.
contents.emmetPreferencesStylusAfter: Symbol to be placed at the end of CSS property when membentangkan CSS abbreviations in Stylus berkas.
contents.emmetPreferencesCssBetween: Symbol to be placed at the between CSS property dan value when membentangkan CSS abbreviations.
contents.emmetPreferencesSassBetween: Symbol to be placed at the between CSS property dan value when membentangkan CSS abbreviations in Sass berkas.
contents.emmetPreferencesStylusBetween: Symbol to be placed at the between CSS property dan value when membentangkan CSS abbreviations in Stylus berkas.
contents.emmetShowSuggestionsAsSnippets: If `true`, then Emmet suggestions will tampilkan up as snippets allowing you to order them as per `#editor.snippetSuggestions#` pengaturan.
contents.emmetPreferencesBemElementSeparator: Element separator used untuk classes when using the BEM filter.
contents.emmetPreferencesBemModifierSeparator: Modifier separator used untuk classes when using the BEM filter.
contents.emmetPreferencesFilterCommentBefore: A definition of comment that should be placed before matched element when comment filter is diterapkan.
contents.emmetPreferencesFilterCommentAfter: A definition of comment that should be placed after matched element when comment filter is diterapkan.
contents.emmetPreferencesFilterCommentTrigger: A comma-separated list of attribute names that should exist in the abbreviation untuk the comment filter to be diterapkan.
contents.emmetPreferencesFormatNoIndentTags: Larik tag names that should never get inner indentation.
contents.emmetPreferencesFormatForceIndentTags: Larik tag names that should always get inner indentation.
contents.emmetPreferencesAllowCompactBoolean: If `true`, compact notation of boolean attributes are produced.
contents.emmetPreferencesCssWebkitProperties: Comma separated CSS properties that get the `webkit` vendor prefix when used in Emmet abbreviation that starts dengan `-`. Set to empty string to always avoid the `webkit` prefix.
contents.emmetPreferencesCssMozProperties: Comma separated CSS properties that get the `moz` vendor prefix when used in Emmet abbreviation that starts dengan `-`. Set to empty string to always avoid the `moz` prefix.
contents.emmetPreferencesCssOProperties: Comma separated CSS properties that get the `o` vendor prefix when used in Emmet abbreviation that starts dengan `-`. Set to empty string to always avoid the `o` prefix.
contents.emmetPreferencesCssMsProperties: Comma separated CSS properties that get the `ms` vendor prefix when used in Emmet abbreviation that starts dengan `-`. Set to empty string to always avoid the `ms` prefix.
contents.emmetPreferencesCssFuzzySearchMinScore: The minimum score (dari 0 to 1) that fuzzy-matched abbreviation should achieve. Lower values may produce many false-positive matches, higher values may reduce possible matches.
contents.emmetOptimizeStylesheetParsing: Saat set to `false`, the whole berkas is parsed to determine if saat ini position is valid untuk membentangkan Emmet abbreviations. When set to `true`, only the content around the saat ini position in CSS/SCSS/Less berkas is parsed.
contents.emmetPreferencesOutputInlineBreak: Jumlah sibling inline elements needed untuk line breaks to be placed between those elements. If `0`, inline elements are always dibentangkan onto a single line.
contents.emmetPreferencesOutputReverseAttributes: If `true`, reverses attribute merging directions when resolving snippets.
contents.emmetPreferencesOutputSelfClosingStyle:
Style of self-menutup tags: html (`
`), xml (`
`) atau xhtml (`
`).
contents.emmetPreferencesCssColorShort: If `true`, color values like `#f` will be dibentangkan to `#fff` instead of `#ffffff`.
contents.emmetUseInlineCompletions: If `true`, Emmet will use inline completions to suggest expansions. To prevent the non-inline completion item provider dari menampilkan up as often while this pengaturan is `true`, turn `#editor.quickSuggestions#` to `inline` atau `off` untuk the `other` item.
